story.iWant: provide user support functionality and operational guidance
story.soThat: I can help users solve problems and successfully use the system
story.tasks:
- [ ] Task 1: Error Knowledge Base System (AC: 1) - [ ] Subtask 1.1: Extend ErrorKnowledgeBase to support comprehensive error documentation - [ ] Subtask 1.2: Create structured error categorization and tagging system - [ ] Subtask 1.3: Implement solution templates and step-by-step resolution guides - [ ] Subtask 1.4: Build knowledge base search and indexing functionality - [ ] Subtask 1.5: Create knowledge base update and version management system
- [ ] Task 2: Interactive Problem Diagnosis Wizard (AC: 2) - [ ] Subtask 2.1: Extend UserConfirmation interface for diagnostic wizard functionality - [ ] Subtask 2.2: Implement decision tree-based problem identification logic - [ ] Subtask 2.3: Create symptom-based diagnosis algorithms - [ ] Subtask 2.4: Build guided troubleshooting step sequences - [ ] Subtask 2.5: Implement diagnosis progress tracking and result reporting
- [ ] Task 3: Technical Support Contact System (AC: 3) - [ ] Subtask 3.1: Create diagnostic information collection module - [ ] Subtask 3.2: Implement system environment snapshot generation - [ ] Subtask 3.3: Build log and error report packaging functionality - [ ] Subtask 3.4: Create support contact interface with multiple channels - [ ] Subtask 3.5: Implement diagnostic data transmission and privacy protection
- [ ] Task 4: Operation Guides and FAQ System (AC: 4) - [ ] Subtask 4.1: Create structured operation guide content management - [ ] Subtask 4.2: Implement FAQ search and recommendation system - [ ] Subtask 4.3: Build interactive guide navigation and progress tracking - [ ] Subtask 4.4: Create context-sensitive help integration - [ ] Subtask 4.5: Implement guide content versioning and updates
- [ ] Task 5: User Feedback Collection System (AC: 5) - [ ] Subtask 5.1: Create feedback collection interface and forms - [ ] Subtask 5.2: Implement feedback categorization and priority assignment - [ ] Subtask 5.3: Build feedback analysis and trend identification - [ ] Subtask 5.4: Create improvement recommendation engine - [ ] Subtask 5.5: Implement feedback-driven system optimization workflows

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. Create a detailed error knowledge base containing common problems and solutions 2. Implement interactive problem diagnosis wizard to guide users through troubleshooting 3. Provide one-click technical support contact functionality with automatic diagnostic information collection 4. Create operation guides and FAQ to help users understand system functionality 5. Implement user feedback collection mechanism for continuous system experience improvement

doc.title: One-Click Launch Epic Breakdown
doc.section: Story 3.3: 用户支持与指导系统
doc.snippet: 作为 一键启动脚本，我需要 提供用户支持功能和操作指导，以便 帮助用户解决问题并成功使用系统。包含5个验收标准：错误知识库、问题诊断向导、技术支持联系、操作指南FAQ、用户反馈收集机制。

doc.title: One-Click Launch Decision Architecture
doc.snippet: 采用纯Python + CLI的跨平台部署自动化架构，使用psutil、rich、requests等核心库，通过智能环境检测、依赖管理和服务编排实现非技术用户10分钟内完成部署。

artifact.reason: Provides comprehensive automatic recovery coordination patterns that can be extended for support system orchestration
Provides existing error categorization and solution storage patterns for extending to comprehensive support knowledge base

constraints.constraint: Support Orchestrator Pattern - Leverage RecoveryOrchestrator patterns from Story 5.2 for comprehensive support coordination
Knowledge Base Management - Extend existing ErrorKnowledgeBase patterns for comprehensive solution and guide storage
Interactive Wizard Pattern - Extend UserConfirmation patterns for guided problem diagnosis and troubleshooting
Progress Tracking - Use ProgressTracker with component_name="user_support" for support operation workflow
Structured Logging - Use structured logging patterns for support session tracking and analysis
Content Management - Follow established configuration and content management patterns
User Interface - Use rich library for beautiful and intuitive support interfaces
Data Collection - Leverage existing diagnostic and monitoring patterns for support data gathering
User Experience First - All support features must be intuitive and accessible to non-technical users
Comprehensive Coverage - Support system should cover all aspects of the one-click launcher functionality
Real-time Assistance - Provide immediate help and guidance during user operations
Privacy Protection - Ensure all user data and diagnostic information is handled with proper privacy safeguards
Multilingual Support - Design for future localization and internationalization
Performance Optimization - Support operations should not impact main launcher performance
Continuous Learning - System should improve from user feedback and support interactions

tests.standards: Support Workflow Testing - Test all support scenarios (knowledge base search, diagnosis wizard, support contact, guides, feedback). User Experience Testing - Validate support interfaces are intuitive and helpful for non-technical users. Content Management Testing - Test knowledge base content updates, version management, and search functionality. Integration Testing - Test support integration with existing error detection, recovery, and service management. Privacy Testing - Validate data collection and privacy protection mechanisms. Performance Testing - Ensure support operations don't impact launcher performance. Usability Testing - Validate support system effectiveness with real user scenarios.
